# Constraints applied only when CI generates requirements-<python>[-dev].txt.
# They select which pandas each CI Python job tests; they are not package metadata.
# Oldest Python: the lowest supported pandas line.
pandas~=2.2.0; python_version < "3.12"
# Middle Pythons: newest pandas 2.x.
pandas<3; python_version >= "3.12" and python_version < "3.14"
# Newest Python: unconstrained, resolves the newest pandas the dependencies allow.
